ul.li: The file must not exist in Salesforce.
The file cannot have been 'Saved as' from an already existing file.

step.cmd: Click Check-in from the X-Author Chatter ribbon.
Select Check-In to My Files and go to the next step or select Check-In to Object and go to step 4.
Enter a filename, add comments and click OK and go to step 7.

stepresult.p: This uploads the file to your Chatter > Files.

step.cmd: Select the object and then select Files if you want to upload the file to the object's Chatter feed. It will be stored as a Feed Attachment file in the Notes and Attachments section of the object.

info.p: Select Attachments to upload it to the Notes and Attachments section.

step.cmd: Enter a name or partial name for the object record and click .

info.p: To configure the fields available for search filters, refer to Configuring Search Criteria.

step.cmd: Click Additional Fields button to capture additional information about the file.

info.p: To enable Additional Fields, refer to Configuring Additional Values.

step.cmd: Select the relationship to see a list of Salesforce records. Update the record details.
Click Select beside the object you want to upload the file to.
Click OK, in the confirmation dialog, which indicates the version of the file.

result.p: The new version of the file is in Salesforce.
